overview_description.description:
Mhlatk is an e-Commerce retail company that provides useful and smart products. The company's mission is to provide users with a more easy and fast online shopping experience, in addition to a wide range of diverse products in various daily fields.

Founded in 2018, Mhlatk is headquartered in Al Ajman, Ajman.
